Industrial Control.reason: Cached skb pointer reuse after reallocation in Intel AMT paths may trigger kernel panics or arbitrary code execution in out-of-band management controllers.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Cached skb pointer reuse after reallocation in Intel AMT paths may trigger kernel panics or arbitrary code execution in out-of-band management controllers.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Intel AMT路径中重新分配后重用缓存的skb指针，可能触发内核崩溃或在带外管理控制器中执行任意代码。

Industrial Control.reason: SQL injection in Faydam Datalogger equipment allows remote database manipulation, potentially disrupting industrial monitoring and control workflows.
Industrial Control.reason_en: SQL injection in Faydam Datalogger equipment allows remote database manipulation, potentially disrupting industrial monitoring and control workflows.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Faydam Datalogger设备中的SQL注入漏洞允许远程数据库操作，进而可能破坏工业监控与控制工作流。

Web Security.reason: Stored cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables attacker-controlled script execution and spoofing within enterprise collaboration portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables attacker-controlled script execution and spoofing within enterprise collaboration portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的存储型跨站脚本漏洞使攻击者能够在企业协作门户中执行受控脚本并进行欺骗。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, representing a critical vulnerability in widely deployed web content management systems.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, representing a critical vulnerability in widely deployed web content management systems.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞允许远程代码执行，这是广泛部署的内容管理系统中的一个关键漏洞。

Web Security.reason: OS command injection in the chenhg5 cc-connect Management API permits remote code execution through manipulated webhook arguments, exposing backend systems to direct compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: OS command injection in the chenhg5 cc-connect Management API permits remote code execution through manipulated webhook arguments, exposing backend systems to direct compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: chenhg5 cc-connect Management API中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许通过篡改Webhook参数实现远程代码执行，使后端系统面临直接沦陷的风险。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in Assessment Management /welcome.php allows unauthorized database manipulation, with publicly available exploits significantly increasing immediate threat levels.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in Assessment Management /welcome.php allows unauthorized database manipulation, with publicly available exploits significantly increasing immediate threat levels.
Web Security.reason_zh: Assessment Management /welcome.php中的SQL注入漏洞允许未经授权的数据库操作，公开可用的利用代码显著提高了即时威胁等级。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 missing authentication in SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation, critically exposing enterprise collaboration and document management platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 missing authentication in SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation, critically exposing enterprise collaboration and document management platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中CVSS 8.8的缺失身份验证漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，严重暴露企业协作与文档管理平台。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 insecure deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution over the network, bypassing standard web application security controls.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 insecure deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution over the network, bypassing standard web application security controls.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中CVSS 8.8的不安全反序列化漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，从而绕过标准Web应用程序安全控制。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.0 authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server permits network privilege escalation, severely compromising corporate email infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.0 authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server permits network privilege escalation, severely compromising corporate email infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server中CVSS 8.0的通过捕获重放实现的身份验证绕过漏洞允许网络权限提升，严重危及企业电子邮件基础设施。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, posing a severe threat to enterprise collaboration platforms and web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, posing a severe threat to enterprise collaboration platforms and web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，对企业协作平台和Web门户构成严重威胁。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely, jeopardizing email infrastructure and internal communications.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely, jeopardizing email infrastructure and internal communications.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行代码，危及电子邮件基础设施和内部通信。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to bypass network restrictions and elevate privileges, facilitating lateral movement within web architectures.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to bypass network restrictions and elevate privileges, facilitating lateral movement within web architectures.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的服务端请求伪造漏洞允许已认证攻击者绕过网络限制并提升权限，促进Web架构内的横向移动。

Web Security.reason: Heap overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution via malicious web content, directly endangering end-user browsers and corporate endpoints.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution via malicious web content, directly endangering end-user browsers and corporate endpoints.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge中的堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意Web内容实现远程代码执行，直接危及终端用户浏览器和企业端点。

Web Security.reason: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution when processing crafted payloads, widely exploited for initial access in enterprise environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution when processing crafted payloads, widely exploited for initial access in enterprise environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的不安全反序列化漏洞在处理构造的有效载荷时允许远程代码执行，在企业环境中被广泛用于获取初始访问权限。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates session hijacking and credential theft against employees accessing enterprise web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates session hijacking and credential theft against employees accessing enterprise web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞助长了对访问企业Web门户员工的会话劫持和凭证窃取。

Web Security.reason: ICEcoder web editor suffers from unauthenticated RCE due to chained authentication and CSRF bypasses combined with unsanitized command execution, enabling immediate server compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: ICEcoder web editor suffers from unauthenticated RCE due to chained authentication and CSRF bypasses combined with unsanitized command execution, enabling immediate server compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: ICEcoder Web编辑器存在未授权RCE漏洞，该漏洞由链式认证与CSRF绕过结合未过滤的命令执行引发，可导致服务器立即被完全控制。

Web Security.reason: Elementor Pro allows unrestricted upload of dangerous file types, enabling attackers to deploy persistent web shells and fully take over WordPress-based applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Elementor Pro allows unrestricted upload of dangerous file types, enabling attackers to deploy persistent web shells and fully take over WordPress-based applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: Elementor Pro允许无限制上传危险文件类型，攻击者可借此部署持久化Webshell并完全接管基于WordPress的应用程序。

Web Security.reason: Etherpad's OAuth authorization logic incorrectly validates admin claims, allowing unauthenticated users to escalate privileges and manipulate shared collaborative documents.
Web Security.reason_en: Etherpad's OAuth authorization logic incorrectly validates admin claims, allowing unauthenticated users to escalate privileges and manipulate shared collaborative documents.
Web Security.reason_zh: Etherpad的OAuth授权逻辑在验证管理员权限时存在缺陷，允许未认证用户进行提权并操纵共享协作文档。

Web Security.reason: Weak URL validation in GetGrav's webhook controller enables SSRF attacks against internal networks by accepting unsafe protocols.
Web Security.reason_en: Weak URL validation in GetGrav's webhook controller enables SSRF attacks against internal networks by accepting unsafe protocols.
Web Security.reason_zh: GetGrav的Webhook控制器存在URL验证薄弱问题，通过接受不安全协议可针对内网发起SSRF攻击。

Web Security.reason: Missing authentication on the WordPress TrueBooker AJAX handler allows direct account creation and administrative takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authentication on the WordPress TrueBooker AJAX handler allows direct account creation and administrative takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress TrueBooker插件的AJAX处理程序缺少身份验证，允许直接创建账户并接管管理员权限。

Web Security.reason: Unvalidated SOCIAL_AUTH keys in MyBooks/Talebook permit newline injection and environment variable manipulation, potentially leading to RCE.
Web Security.reason_en: Unvalidated SOCIAL_AUTH keys in MyBooks/Talebook permit newline injection and environment variable manipulation, potentially leading to RCE.
Web Security.reason_zh: MyBooks/Talebook中未经验证的SOCIAL_AUTH密钥允许换行符注入和篡改环境变量，可能导致RCE。

Web Security.reason: SimpleSAMLphp incorrectly treats unsigned embedded SAML responses as cryptographically valid, enabling cross-identity provider authentication bypasses.
Web Security.reason_en: SimpleSAMLphp incorrectly treats unsigned embedded SAML responses as cryptographically valid, enabling cross-identity provider authentication bypasses.
Web Security.reason_zh: SimpleSAMLphp错误地将未签名的嵌入式SAML响应视为密码学有效，从而可实现跨身份提供商的认证绕过。

Web Security.reason: MediaWiki Maps extension accepts attacker-controlled HTML in overlay parameters, resulting in stored XSS within dynamic geographic visualizations.
Web Security.reason_en: MediaWiki Maps extension accepts attacker-controlled HTML in overlay parameters, resulting in stored XSS within dynamic geographic visualizations.
Web Security.reason_zh: MediaWiki Maps扩展在叠加层参数中接受攻击者控制的HTML，导致动态地理可视化中出现存储型XSS漏洞。

Web Security.reason: Grav CMS dynamically invokes user-supplied class methods via blueprint data, granting admin users arbitrary code execution capabilities.
Web Security.reason_en: Grav CMS dynamically invokes user-supplied class methods via blueprint data, granting admin users arbitrary code execution capabilities.
Web Security.reason_zh: Grav CMS通过蓝图数据动态调用用户提供的类方法，使管理员用户获得任意代码执行能力。

Web Security.reason: Internet Explorer memory corruption allows arbitrary code execution via malicious web content, remaining critical for legacy enterprise browser environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Internet Explorer memory corruption allows arbitrary code execution via malicious web content, remaining critical for legacy enterprise browser environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Internet Explorer内存损坏漏洞可通过恶意网页内容实现任意代码执行，在遗留企业浏览器环境中仍属高危漏洞。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Grav's shortcode plugin allows stored XSS attacks, compromising web applications relying on BBCode-style formatting.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Grav's shortcode plugin allows stored XSS attacks, compromising web applications relying on BBCode-style formatting.
Web Security.reason_zh: Grav的短代码插件存在跨站脚本漏洞，可触发存储型XSS攻击，危及依赖BBCode风格格式化的Web应用程序。

Web Security.reason: Memory corruption in Internet Explorer remains a high-value target for drive-by download campaigns exploiting legacy enterprise deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Memory corruption in Internet Explorer remains a high-value target for drive-by download campaigns exploiting legacy enterprise deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Internet Explorer的内存损坏漏洞仍是利用遗留企业部署进行旁路下载攻击的高价值目标。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Data Quality enables internal network scanning and credential theft from backend microservices.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Data Quality enables internal network scanning and credential theft from backend microservices.
Web Security.reason_zh: Data Quality中的服务端请求伪造漏洞可用于内网扫描及从后端微服务窃取凭证。

Web Security.reason: Origin validation failure in Chromium-based Edge facilitates sophisticated phishing and token theft via malicious iframe injection.
Web Security.reason_en: Origin validation failure in Chromium-based Edge facilitates sophisticated phishing and token theft via malicious iframe injection.
Web Security.reason_zh: Chromium版Edge的源验证失败漏洞可通过恶意iframe注入助长高级钓鱼攻击与令牌窃取。

Web Security.reason: Severe type confusion in the Chromium engine facilitates remote code execution by exploiting object misinterpretation during page rendering.
Web Security.reason_en: Severe type confusion in the Chromium engine facilitates remote code execution by exploiting object misinterpretation during page rendering.
Web Security.reason_zh: Chromium引擎中严重的类型混淆漏洞可利用页面渲染期间的对象误判实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Insecure deserialization of untrusted data in Edge allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands via crafted web payloads.
Web Security.reason_en: Insecure deserialization of untrusted data in Edge allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands via crafted web payloads.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge中对不可信数据的不安全反序列化漏洞允许攻击者通过构造的Web载荷执行任意命令。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint enables attackers to inject malicious scripts, leading to session hijacking and credential theft in web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint enables attackers to inject malicious scripts, leading to session hijacking and credential theft in web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞使攻击者能够注入恶意脚本，导致Web门户发生会话劫持与凭证窃取。

Web Security.reason: Information disclosure in Power BI exposes sensitive business analytics data, violating confidentiality requirements for enterprise reporting and visualization tools.
Web Security.reason_en: Information disclosure in Power BI exposes sensitive business analytics data, violating confidentiality requirements for enterprise reporting and visualization tools.
Web Security.reason_zh: Power BI的信息泄露漏洞会暴露敏感的业务分析数据，违反企业报表与可视化工具的保密性要求。

Web Security.reason: Injection flaw in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows bypassing security controls, risking exposure of proprietary code and secrets during software development.
Web Security.reason_en: Injection flaw in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows bypassing security controls, risking exposure of proprietary code and secrets during software development.
Web Security.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot和Visual Studio中的注入缺陷可绕过安全控制，在软件开发过程中增加专有代码与机密泄露风险。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in SQL Server allows privilege escalation over a network. Direct database manipulation poses severe risks to data integrity and confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server allows privilege escalation over a network. Direct database manipulation poses severe risks to data integrity and confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_zh: SQL Server中的SQL注入漏洞允许通过网络进行提权。直接操作数据库对数据完整性与机密性构成严重威胁。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables spoofing and session hijacking. Enterprise collaboration platforms are high-value targets for credential theft and lateral movement.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables spoofing and session hijacking. Enterprise collaboration platforms are high-value targets for credential theft and lateral movement.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致欺骗与会话劫持。企业协作平台是凭证窃取与横向移动的高价值目标。

Web Security.reason: Infinite loop in Active Directory Federation Services causes denial of service. Disrupting AD FS blocks single sign-on capabilities for entire organizations, halting business operations.
Web Security.reason_en: Infinite loop in Active Directory Federation Services causes denial of service. Disrupting AD FS blocks single sign-on capabilities for entire organizations, halting business operations.
Web Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services中的无限循环会导致拒绝服务。中断AD FS将阻断整个组织的单点登录功能，致使业务停滞。

Web Security.reason: Combined XSS and CSRF flaws in Power BI Report Server enable session hijacking and unauthorized report manipulation within business intelligence platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Combined XSS and CSRF flaws in Power BI Report Server enable session hijacking and unauthorized report manipulation within business intelligence platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: Power BI Report Server中结合的XSS与CSRF漏洞可导致会话劫持及商业智能平台内的报告未经授权使用与篡改。

Web Security.reason: Microsoft Edge Chromium-based remote code execution vulnerability directly impacts endpoint security and increases susceptibility to drive-by attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Microsoft Edge Chromium-based remote code execution vulnerability directly impacts endpoint security and increases susceptibility to drive-by attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的Microsoft Edge远程代码执行漏洞直接影响终端安全，并增加遭受旁路攻击的风险。

Web Security.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in Chromium-based Edge enables remote code execution via crafted web pages, posing a direct threat to end-user browser security.
Web Security.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Chromium-based Edge enables remote code execution via crafted web pages, posing a direct threat to end-user browser security.
Web Security.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的Edge中存在释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可通过构造的网页实现远程代码执行，直接威胁终端用户的浏览器安全。

Web Security.reason: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to trigger denial-of-service conditions, disrupting web application availability and backend microservices.
Web Security.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to trigger denial-of-service conditions, disrupting web application availability and backend microservices.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的资源耗尽漏洞允许攻击者触发拒绝服务状态，破坏Web应用程序可用性及后端微服务。

Web Security.reason: Remote code execution in the legacy MSHTML platform remains relevant for organizations relying on older web rendering components, enabling script injection and payload delivery.
Web Security.reason_en: Remote code execution in the legacy MSHTML platform remains relevant for organizations relying on older web rendering components, enabling script injection and payload delivery.
Web Security.reason_zh: 遗留MSHTML平台中的远程代码执行漏洞对依赖旧版网页渲染组件的组织仍具威胁，可实现脚本注入与载荷投递。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables immediate remote code execution, threatening critical collaboration platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables immediate remote code execution, threatening critical collaboration platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中正在被积极利用的反序列化缺陷可导致即时远程代码执行，威胁关键协作平台的安全。

Web Security.reason: Continues to be leveraged by threat actors to compromise email infrastructure, leading to widespread data exfiltration and service disruption.
Web Security.reason_en: Continues to be leveraged by threat actors to compromise email infrastructure, leading to widespread data exfiltration and service disruption.
Web Security.reason_zh: 该漏洞持续被威胁行为体利用以入侵邮件基础设施，导致大规模数据外泄与服务中断。

Web Security.reason: Memory corruption vulnerability in the browser engine allows remote code execution via malicious web content, impacting end-user security.
Web Security.reason_en: Memory corruption vulnerability in the browser engine allows remote code execution via malicious web content, impacting end-user security.
Web Security.reason_zh: 浏览器引擎中的内存损坏漏洞可通过恶意网页内容实现远程代码执行，严重影响终端用户安全。

Web Security.reason: High exploit probability (EPSS 0.82) indicates active targeting, allowing attackers to gain administrative control over mail servers.
Web Security.reason_en: High exploit probability (EPSS 0.82) indicates active targeting, allowing attackers to gain administrative control over mail servers.
Web Security.reason_zh: 较高的利用概率（EPSS 0.82）表明存在主动攻击目标，攻击者可借此获取邮件服务器的管理员控制权。

Web Security.reason: A critical cross-site scripting vulnerability in Exchange Server enables network-wide spoofing and session hijacking attacks against web-facing mail interfaces.
Web Security.reason_en: A critical cross-site scripting vulnerability in Exchange Server enables network-wide spoofing and session hijacking attacks against web-facing mail interfaces.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中存在一个严重的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可导致针对面向 Web 的邮件接口进行全网范围的欺骗和会话劫持攻击。

Web Security.reason: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core allows denial-of-service against web applications due to missing throttling controls, impacting availability.
Web Security.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core allows denial-of-service against web applications due to missing throttling controls, impacting availability.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞因缺少限流控制，可导致 Web 应用程序遭受拒绝服务攻击，影响系统可用性。

Web Security.reason: Improper handling of missing special elements in .NET enables network spoofing, undermining foundational web framework security guarantees.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper handling of missing special elements in .NET enables network spoofing, undermining foundational web framework security guarantees.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET 中对缺失特殊元素的处理不当会导致网络欺骗，破坏了基础 Web 框架的安全保障机制。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core undermines session integrity across millions of enterprise web applications built on this widely adopted framework.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core undermines session integrity across millions of enterprise web applications built on this widely adopted framework.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证绕过漏洞破坏了基于该广泛采用框架构建的数百万企业 Web 应用程序的会话完整性。

Web Security.reason: Type confusion vulnerability in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge poses a direct risk of remote code execution for end-users visiting malicious sites.
Web Security.reason_en: Type confusion vulnerability in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge poses a direct risk of remote code execution for end-users visiting malicious sites.
Web Security.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Microsoft Edge 中存在类型混淆漏洞，访问恶意网站的用户面临直接的远程代码执行风险。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site request forgery in a popular WordPress notification bar plugin could allow attackers to manipulate site settings or inject malicious content at scale.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site request forgery in a popular WordPress notification bar plugin could allow attackers to manipulate site settings or inject malicious content at scale.
Web Security.reason_zh: 某流行的 WordPress 通知栏插件存在跨站请求伪造（CSRF）漏洞，攻击者可能借此大规模篡改站点设置或注入恶意内容。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload bypasses MIME checks, allowing immediate remote code execution on vulnerable Joomla websites.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload bypasses MIME checks, allowing immediate remote code execution on vulnerable Joomla websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: 未认证的任意文件上传漏洞绕过了 MIME 检查，可在易受攻击的 Joomla 网站上立即实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal and weak extension checks combined with CSRF enable arbitrary file deletion and upload, fully compromising Joomla business directory installations.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal and weak extension checks combined with CSRF enable arbitrary file deletion and upload, fully compromising Joomla business directory installations.
Web Security.reason_zh: 路径遍历与薄弱的扩展名检查结合 CSRF 漏洞，可实现任意文件删除与上传，从而完全攻破 Joomla 商业目录安装实例。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated SQL injection in Maps Marker Pro exposes sensitive database contents without requiring any user credentials or login.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in Maps Marker Pro exposes sensitive database contents without requiring any user credentials or login.
Web Security.reason_zh: Maps Marker Pro 中存在未认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，无需任何用户凭据或登录即可暴露敏感的数据库内容。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated SQL injection in donation forms allows attackers to extract or modify critical financial and user data from public-facing web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in donation forms allows attackers to extract or modify critical financial and user data from public-facing web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: 捐赠表单中的未认证 SQL 注入漏洞使攻击者能够从面向公众的 Web 应用程序中提取或修改关键的财务和用户数据。

Web Security.reason: Prompt injection via MCP server custom instructions poisons AI coding agents, leading to malicious code generation or sensitive data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Prompt injection via MCP server custom instructions poisons AI coding agents, leading to malicious code generation or sensitive data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过 MCP 服务器自定义指令进行的提示词注入会污染 AI 编程代理，导致恶意代码生成或敏感数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: Missing access grant checks in API endpoints allow non-super users to create and manage API keys, bypassing intended authorization flows in headless CMS setups.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing access grant checks in API endpoints allow non-super users to create and manage API keys, bypassing intended authorization flows in headless CMS setups.
Web Security.reason_zh: API 端点中缺失的访问授权检查允许非超级用户创建和管理 API 密钥，从而绕过无头 CMS 架构中的预期授权流程。

Web Security.reason: LDAP authentication bypass unconditionally activates accounts, overwriting local status flags and undermining multi-factor security controls in web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: LDAP authentication bypass unconditionally activates accounts, overwriting local status flags and undermining multi-factor security controls in web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: LDAP 身份验证绕过漏洞会无条件激活账户，覆盖本地状态标志，破坏 Web 门户中的多因素安全控制机制。

Web Security.reason: Subscriber SQL injection targets membership databases, exposing customer PII and subscription details in widely deployed e-commerce plugins.
Web Security.reason_en: Subscriber SQL injection targets membership databases, exposing customer PII and subscription details in widely deployed e-commerce plugins.
Web Security.reason_zh: Subscriber 插件的 SQL 注入漏洞针对会员数据库，在广泛部署的电子商务插件中暴露客户个人身份信息（PII）及订阅详情。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated PHP code injection via form post-submission handlers enables complete web server compromise and arbitrary code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP code injection via form post-submission handlers enables complete web server compromise and arbitrary code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过表单提交后处理程序进行的未认证 PHP 代码注入可导致 Web 服务器被完全接管并执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Missing security restrictions in Grav CMS allow delegated administrators to escalate to super-admin status, gaining dangerous scheduler and template evaluation capabilities.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing security restrictions in Grav CMS allow delegated administrators to escalate to super-admin status, gaining dangerous scheduler and template evaluation capabilities.
Web Security.reason_zh: Grav CMS 中缺失的安全限制允许委托管理员提权至超级管理员状态，从而获得危险的计划任务调度与模板评估能力。

Web Security.reason: Two-factor authentication bypass via premature remember-me token issuance allows attackers to skip 2FA challenges and maintain persistent unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_en: Two-factor authentication bypass via premature remember-me token issuance allows attackers to skip 2FA challenges and maintain persistent unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过过早发放“记住我”令牌实现的二次验证绕过漏洞，使攻击者能够跳过 2FA 挑战并保持持久的未授权访问。

Web Security.reason: Helidon's Imperative Web Server suffers an easily exploitable vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via HTTP, threatening modern microservices architectures.
Web Security.reason_en: Helidon's Imperative Web Server suffers an easily exploitable vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via HTTP, threatening modern microservices architectures.
Web Security.reason_zh: Helidon 的命令式 Web 服务器存在易于利用的漏洞，可通过 HTTP 实现未认证的远程代码执行，威胁现代微服务架构。

Web Security.reason: Axios prototype pollution gadgets enable attackers to escalate dependency-level pollution into full Man-in-the-Middle attacks, compromising request/response integrity in Node.js and browser environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Axios prototype pollution gadgets enable attackers to escalate dependency-level pollution into full Man-in-the-Middle attacks, compromising request/response integrity in Node.js and browser environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Axios 的原型污染利用链使攻击者能够将依赖级污染升级为完整的中间人攻击，破坏 Node.js 和浏览器环境中的请求/响应完整性。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the popular WordPress JetEngine plugin directly exposes millions of sites to complete takeover without user interaction.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the popular WordPress JetEngine plugin directly exposes millions of sites to complete takeover without user interaction.
Web Security.reason_zh: 流行的 WordPress JetEngine 插件中存在未认证的远程代码执行漏洞，无需用户交互即可直接导致数百万个站点被完全接管。

Web Security.reason: The fast-xml-parser treats dots in DOCTYPE entity names as regex wildcards, allowing attackers to shadow built-in entities and trigger XML injection or XSS in web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: The fast-xml-parser treats dots in DOCTYPE entity names as regex wildcards, allowing attackers to shadow built-in entities and trigger XML injection or XSS in web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: fast-xml-parser 将 DOCTYPE 实体名称中的点号视为正则通配符，使攻击者能够遮蔽内置实体并在 Web 应用中触发 XML 注入或 XSS。

Web Security.reason: Insufficient state checks in Joomla Core enable attackers to bypass multi-factor authentication, granting unauthorized administrative access.
Web Security.reason_en: Insufficient state checks in Joomla Core enable attackers to bypass multi-factor authentication, granting unauthorized administrative access.
Web Security.reason_zh: Joomla Core 中状态检查不足使攻击者能够绕过多因素认证，从而获得未授权的管理员访问权限。

Web Security.reason: Unrestricted upload of executable SHTML files in Joomla allows attackers to achieve remote code execution on servers configured to parse server-side includes.
Web Security.reason_en: Unrestricted upload of executable SHTML files in Joomla allows attackers to achieve remote code execution on servers configured to parse server-side includes.
Web Security.reason_zh: Joomla 中不受限制的 SHTML 可执行文件上传漏洞，使攻击者能够在配置了服务端包含（SSI）解析的服务器上实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Sandbox escape in Node.js vm2 library allows malicious code to access host objects via unsanitized Error.cause properties, breaking isolation guarantees.
Web Security.reason_en: Sandbox escape in Node.js vm2 library allows malicious code to access host objects via unsanitized Error.cause properties, breaking isolation guarantees.
Web Security.reason_zh: Node.js vm2 库的沙箱逃逸漏洞允许恶意代码通过未过滤的 Error.cause 属性访问主机对象，破坏隔离保证。

Web Security.reason: Faulty backslash escaping in shell-quote JavaScript utility can lead to command injection when line terminators are processed incorrectly in operator tokens.
Web Security.reason_en: Faulty backslash escaping in shell-quote JavaScript utility can lead to command injection when line terminators are processed incorrectly in operator tokens.
Web Security.reason_zh: shell-quote JavaScript 工具中反斜杠转义逻辑缺陷，当操作数令牌中的行终止符处理不当时，可能导致命令注入。

Web Security.reason: Memory exhaustion denial-of-service vulnerability in ws WebSocket library allows peers to flood connections with malformed frames, crashing Node.js applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Memory exhaustion denial-of-service vulnerability in ws WebSocket library allows peers to flood connections with malformed frames, crashing Node.js applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: ws WebSocket 库中的内存耗尽拒绝服务漏洞允许对等节点使用畸形帧洪水攻击连接，导致 Node.js 应用程序崩溃。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unsafe pickle deserialization in LMDeploy peer messaging allows remote code execution, severely compromising AI model serving infrastructure and backend reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unsafe pickle deserialization in LMDeploy peer messaging allows remote code execution, severely compromising AI model serving infrastructure and backend reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: LMDeploy 对等消息传递中的不安全 pickle 反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，严重破坏 AI 模型推理基础设施与后端可靠性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Missing input validation in Splunk MCP Server enables arbitrary OS command execution by admin users, risking full platform takeover in SIEM and log analytics environments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Missing input validation in Splunk MCP Server enables arbitrary OS command execution by admin users, risking full platform takeover in SIEM and log analytics environments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Splunk MCP Server 中缺失输入验证使管理员用户能够执行任意操作系统命令，在 SIEM 和日志分析环境中面临平台被完全接管的风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Kerberos HTTP Event Collector misconfiguration in Splunk Connect for Kafka allows unauthenticated data interception, breaking secure log pipeline integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Kerberos HTTP Event Collector misconfiguration in Splunk Connect for Kafka allows unauthenticated data interception, breaking secure log pipeline integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Splunk Connect for Kafka 中 Kerberos HTTP Event Collector 的配置错误允许未认证的数据拦截，破坏安全日志管道的完整性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Deserialization flaw in on-premises Dynamics 365 allows remote code execution over the network, directly endangering enterprise resource planning systems and backend databases.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in on-premises Dynamics 365 allows remote code execution over the network, directly endangering enterprise resource planning systems and backend databases.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 本地部署版 Dynamics 365 中的反序列化漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，直接威胁企业资源规划系统和后端数据库。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unchecked input for loop conditions in the .NET framework enables denial-of-service attacks over the network, disrupting middleware services and web applications relying on the runtime.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unchecked input for loop conditions in the .NET framework enables denial-of-service attacks over the network, disrupting middleware services and web applications relying on the runtime.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中循环条件的输入未经验证，可导致网络拒绝服务攻击，破坏依赖该运行时的中间件服务和 Web 应用程序。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper channel restriction in Azure SQL Managed Instance allows privilege escalation between isolated database tenants, violating multi-tenancy security models.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper channel restriction in Azure SQL Managed Instance allows privilege escalation between isolated database tenants, violating multi-tenancy security models.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Azure SQL Managed Instance 中的通道限制不当，允许在隔离的数据库租户之间进行权限提升，违反了多租户安全模型。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in Azure Service Bus enables remote code execution, compromising message queue middleware used in critical application architectures.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Azure Service Bus enables remote code execution, compromising message queue middleware used in critical application architectures.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 中对不受信任数据的反序列化可启用远程代码执行，危及关键应用架构中使用的消息队列中间件。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Manager contains an easily exploitable vulnerability allowing unauthenticated network attackers to compromise the entire CRM deployment and steal business data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Manager contains an easily exploitable vulnerability allowing unauthenticated network attackers to compromise the entire CRM deployment and steal business data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Manager 存在一个易于利用的漏洞，允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者入侵整个 CRM 部署并窃取业务数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Oracle Siebel CRM Migration component flaw enables low-privileged attackers to disrupt deployment pipelines and inject malicious configurations via HTTP, undermining middleware reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Oracle Siebel CRM Migration component flaw enables low-privileged attackers to disrupt deployment pipelines and inject malicious configurations via HTTP, undermining middleware reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle Siebel CRM 迁移组件缺陷使低权限攻击者能够破坏部署流水线并通过 HTTP 注入恶意配置，削弱中间件的可靠性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Easily exploitable IIOP vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise middleware.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Easily exploitable IIOP vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise middleware.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server 中存在易于利用的 IIOP 漏洞，允许在企业中间件上执行未经身份验证的远程代码。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Critical T3/IIOP flaw enables low-privileged attackers to fully compromise WebLogic instances, disrupting backend application services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Critical T3/IIOP flaw enables low-privileged attackers to fully compromise WebLogic instances, disrupting backend application services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 关键的 T3/IIOP 缺陷使低权限攻击者能够完全控制 WebLogic 实例，破坏后端应用程序服务。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in Oracle Identity Manager compromises legacy UI components and disrupts identity provisioning workflows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in Oracle Identity Manager compromises legacy UI components and disrupts identity provisioning workflows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle Identity Manager 中的未经身份验证的 HTTP 漏洞会破坏遗留 UI 组件并中断身份配置工作流。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Low-privileged HTTP exploitation in Oracle WebCenter Portal Composer allows full compromise of enterprise content delivery and portal management.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Low-privileged HTTP exploitation in Oracle WebCenter Portal Composer allows full compromise of enterprise content delivery and portal management.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle WebCenter Portal Composer 中的低权限 HTTP 利用可导致企业内容分发和门户管理被完全控制。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Windows Jet Database Engine remote code execution via crafted file openings exposes database-dependent applications to immediate exploitation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Windows Jet Database Engine remote code execution via crafted file openings exposes database-dependent applications to immediate exploitation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Windows Jet Database Engine 通过构造的文件打开操作实现远程代码执行，使依赖数据库的应用程序面临即时利用风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Similar memory handling flaw in the Jet Engine exacerbates exposure for systems relying on legacy Access databases or OLEDB providers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Similar memory handling flaw in the Jet Engine exacerbates exposure for systems relying on legacy Access databases or OLEDB providers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Jet Engine 中类似的内存处理缺陷加剧了依赖旧版 Access 数据库或 OLEDB 提供程序的系统的暴露面。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Remote code execution in the Jet Database Engine allows attackers to execute code by opening specially crafted database files on shared drives.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Remote code execution in the Jet Database Engine allows attackers to execute code by opening specially crafted database files on shared drives.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Jet Database Engine 中的远程代码执行漏洞允许攻击者通过打开共享驱动器上的特制数据库文件来执行代码。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Authentication bypass in Exchange Online permits unauthorized email tampering and mailbox compromise at scale across organizational tenants.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Exchange Online permits unauthorized email tampering and mailbox compromise at scale across organizational tenants.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Exchange Online 中的身份验证绕过允许跨组织租户大规模进行未经授权邮件篡改和邮箱入侵。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Access control bypass in the Extensible Storage Engine (ESENT) permits local privilege escalation during database file operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Access control bypass in the Extensible Storage Engine (ESENT) permits local privilege escalation during database file operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 可扩展存储引擎 (ESENT) 中的访问控制绕过可在数据库文件操作期间允许本地权限提升。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Use-after-free in the Linux Ceph kernel module can crash storage clusters or escalate privileges, jeopardizing the reliability of distributed database backends.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Linux Ceph kernel module can crash storage clusters or escalate privileges, jeopardizing the reliability of distributed database backends.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Linux Ceph 内核模块中的释放后使用漏洞可能导致存储集群崩溃或权限提升，危及分布式数据库后端的可靠性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper validation of CRUSH bucket types triggers out-of-bounds reads, potentially destabilizing Ceph storage routing and data retrieval operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper validation of CRUSH bucket types triggers out-of-bounds reads, potentially destabilizing Ceph storage routing and data retrieval operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: CRUSH 桶类型验证不当会触发越界读取，可能破坏 Ceph 存储路由和数据检索操作的稳定性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Multiplication overflow in Ceph message decoding causes out-of-bounds memory access, threatening middleware reliability in large-scale distributed deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Multiplication overflow in Ceph message decoding causes out-of-bounds memory access, threatening middleware reliability in large-scale distributed deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Ceph 消息解码中的乘法溢出会导致越界内存访问，威胁大规模分布式部署中中间件的可靠性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper authorization in Active Directory Certificate Services allows privilege escalation over a network. Attackers can forge certificates to impersonate users or systems, effectively breaking PKI trust models.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper authorization in Active Directory Certificate Services allows privilege escalation over a network. Attackers can forge certificates to impersonate users or systems, effectively breaking PKI trust models.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中的授权不当允许通过网络进行权限提升。攻击者可伪造证书冒充用户或系统，从而破坏 PKI 信任模型。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Incorrect authorization in .NET allows bypassing security features over a network. Runtime authorization flaws undermine application-level access controls and API gateways.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in .NET allows bypassing security features over a network. Runtime authorization flaws undermine application-level access controls and API gateways.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET 中的授权错误允许通过网络绕过安全功能。运行时授权缺陷会削弱应用程序级访问控制和 API 网关。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper restriction of names in GitHub Copilot allows local code execution. Vulnerabilities in AI-assisted development tools can introduce malicious payloads directly into developer workspaces.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper restriction of names in GitHub Copilot allows local code execution. Vulnerabilities in AI-assisted development tools can introduce malicious payloads directly into developer workspaces.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 中的名称限制不当允许本地代码执行。AI 辅助开发工具中的漏洞可直接将恶意有效载荷引入开发者工作区。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Remote code execution in Microsoft SQL Server directly compromises database engines, risking data exfiltration, ransomware deployment, and full system takeover.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Remote code execution in Microsoft SQL Server directly compromises database engines, risking data exfiltration, ransomware deployment, and full system takeover.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的远程代码执行直接危及数据库引擎，可能导致数据泄露、勒索软件部署及系统完全接管。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Vulnerability in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL Server allows remote code execution when connecting to databases, expanding the attack surface for data access layers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Vulnerability in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL Server allows remote code execution when connecting to databases, expanding the attack surface for data access layers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序存在漏洞，连接数据库时可导致远程代码执行，扩大了数据访问层的攻击面。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Allows remote code execution within the database engine via crafted requests, risking complete data breach and system compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Allows remote code execution within the database engine via crafted requests, risking complete data breach and system compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 通过构造的请求在数据库引擎内允许远程代码执行，可能导致全面数据泄露与系统沦陷。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Directly compromises the database service, enabling attackers to manipulate data, escalate privileges, and pivot to other internal systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Directly compromises the database service, enabling attackers to manipulate data, escalate privileges, and pivot to other internal systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 直接危及数据库服务，使攻击者能够操纵数据、提升权限并横向移动至其他内部系统。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Flaw in the core data access driver allows remote code execution when connecting to databases, breaking the security boundary of data tiers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Flaw in the core data access driver allows remote code execution when connecting to databases, breaking the security boundary of data tiers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 核心数据访问驱动程序的缺陷在连接数据库时允许远程代码执行，破坏了数据层的安全边界。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Causes service disruptions in hosted .NET applications, impacting availability for dependent web and enterprise services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Causes service disruptions in hosted .NET applications, impacting availability for dependent web and enterprise services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 导致托管 .NET 应用程序的服务中断，影响依赖型 Web 和企业服务的可用性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Remote code execution in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL Server compromises database connectivity layers and backend storage systems at the middleware level.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Remote code execution in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL Server compromises database connectivity layers and backend storage systems at the middleware level.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的远程代码执行会破坏中间件层面的数据库连接层和后端存储系统。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server permits network-based code execution, destabilizing enterprise messaging middleware deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server permits network-based code execution, destabilizing enterprise messaging middleware deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许基于网络的代码执行，破坏企业消息传递中间件部署的稳定性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Insufficient access control granularity in Exchange allows local privilege escalation within middleware environments, weakening isolation boundaries.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Insufficient access control granularity in Exchange allows local privilege escalation within middleware environments, weakening isolation boundaries.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Exchange 中访问控制粒度不足允许在中间件环境中进行本地权限提升，削弱了隔离边界。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Network-accessible heap overflow in the SQL Server ODBC driver enables unauthenticated remote code execution directly against database services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Network-accessible heap overflow in the SQL Server ODBC driver enables unauthenticated remote code execution directly against database services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server ODBC 驱动中存在网络可访问的堆溢出漏洞，可直接针对数据库服务实现未认证的远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated compromise of Oracle Database Portable Clusterware disrupts high-availability architectures and grants lateral movement across database nodes.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated compromise of Oracle Database Portable Clusterware disrupts high-availability architectures and grants lateral movement across database nodes.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle Database Portable Clusterware 遭未认证入侵会破坏高可用架构，并允许攻击者在数据库节点间进行横向移动。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Bypassed field-level authentication rules in Neo4j GraphQL implementations expose sensitive graph data to unauthorized API consumers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Bypassed field-level authentication rules in Neo4j GraphQL implementations expose sensitive graph data to unauthorized API consumers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Neo4j GraphQL 实现中绕过的字段级认证规则会将敏感图数据暴露给未授权的 API 消费者。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Easily exploitable unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability compromises the imperative web server, disrupting Java-based microservices and enterprise middleware architectures.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Easily exploitable unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability compromises the imperative web server, disrupting Java-based microservices and enterprise middleware architectures.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 易于利用的未认证 HTTP 漏洞可攻陷 Imperative Web Server，破坏基于 Java 的微服务和企业中间件架构。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated network access via HTTP allows remote attackers to compromise the Helidon web server framework, impacting downstream application reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated network access via HTTP allows remote attackers to compromise the Helidon web server framework, impacting downstream application reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 通过 HTTP 进行的未认证网络访问允许远程攻击者攻陷 Helidon Web 服务器框架，影响下游应用程序的可靠性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Critical HTTP handling flaw enables unauthenticated compromise, posing significant risks to enterprise middleware deployments and API gateways.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Critical HTTP handling flaw enables unauthenticated compromise, posing significant risks to enterprise middleware deployments and API gateways.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 关键的 HTTP 处理缺陷可导致未认证入侵，对企业中间件部署和 API 网关构成重大风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated HTTP access to the Open Integration component allows easy compromise of enterprise CRM middleware and data synchronization pipelines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP access to the Open Integration component allows easy compromise of enterprise CRM middleware and data synchronization pipelines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 对 Open Integration 组件的未认证 HTTP 访问可轻易导致企业 CRM 中间件和数据同步管道被攻陷。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Low-privileged network attackers can compromise Siebel REST integration endpoints, disrupting business workflow automation and middleware connectivity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Low-privileged network attackers can compromise Siebel REST integration endpoints, disrupting business workflow automation and middleware connectivity.
